items.stem: In the 'Summarise Written Text' task, a response must be written as which of the following?

options.text: A single sentence within the stated word limit
options.rationale: Correct: the task requires one sentence within the specified word range.
The essay format belongs to the essay task, not summarise-written-text.

options.text: A bulleted list of key points
options.rationale: The task requires a single coherent sentence, not bullets.

options.text: A spoken response recorded by microphone
options.rationale: This is a written task, not a speaking task.

items.explanation: Correct: the task requires one sentence within the specified word range.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which strategy best fits the 'Re-order Paragraphs' reading task?

options.text: Identify the topic sentence and trace referential links between sentences
options.rationale: Correct: locating the opening idea and following cohesive links (pronouns, connectors) reconstructs the order.

options.text: Arrange sentences alphabetically by first word
options.rationale: Alphabetical order has nothing to do with logical sequence.

options.text: Pick the longest sentence to go first
options.rationale: Sentence length does not determine position.
Random guessing ignores the available cohesion cues.

items.explanation: Correct: locating the opening idea and following cohesive links (pronouns, connectors) reconstructs the order.

options.rationale: Correct: grammatical accuracy is a scored trait in written responses.

Responses are typed, so handwriting is not scored.

options.text: The colour of the candidate's clothing

options.rationale: Native language is not a scored feature of the response.
